notes: Source: Lex Products' own product detail page (powerhouse_detail?part=DBS100DT-B4BI2), titled "300 Amp Pagoda Jr.™ Motion Picture Box" — the "300A" in the marketing name reflects combined output capacity across the 3 stage-pin legs (3 x 100A), while the unit's actual branch/service rating is 100A, 120/208Y VAC, 3-phase, 60Hz, NEMA Type 1 (indoor only), cULus listed. Portable molded-rubber "Pagoda Jr." lunchbox enclosure (11.38"L x 11.38"W x 11.32"H, 24.0 lbs) — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. Overcurrent protection: 3x 100A hydraulic-magnetic breakers (stage pin legs) + 3x 20A hydraulic-magnetic breakers (Edison legs), all under a hinged lid. None of the device's actual connectors (16-Series Cam-type/Camlok input pins, Stage Pin/Bates outputs, NEMA 5-20 Edison outputs) have an exact id in the allowed connector enum, so each was mapped to its closest listed proxy (see per-port notes) — this is the main source of residual uncertainty, not the underlying spec data itself, which came directly from the manufacturer.

ports.name: Input (3-Phase Cam)
ports.note: Real connector: (1) set of 5x 16-Series single-pole Cam-type (Camlok) pins on 1.5ft pigtails, 400A/600V-rated pins, wired L1/L2/L3/N/G for 100A/120-208Y VAC 3-phase service. No cam-lock id exists in the allowed list; 'banana' chosen as the closest single-pole friction-pin proxy, not a literal banana plug.

ports.name: Stage Pin Out 1
ports.note: Real connector: Stage Pin (Bates) receptacle, 2-pole+ground, 100A/250VAC, individual round twist/friction pins. No matching id in the allowed list; 'banana' used as closest single round-pin proxy.

ports.name: Stage Pin Out 2
ports.note: Real connector: Stage Pin (Bates) receptacle, 2-pole+ground, 100A/250VAC. Proxied to 'banana' (closest single round-pin connector in the allowed list).

ports.name: Stage Pin Out 3
ports.note: Real connector: Stage Pin (Bates) receptacle, 2-pole+ground, 100A/250VAC. Proxied to 'banana' (closest single round-pin connector in the allowed list).

ports.name: Edison Out 1
ports.note: Real connector: NEMA 5-20 (Edison) straight-blade receptacle, 20A/125VAC. The allowed list has no 5-20 id; mapped to the closest household blade-connector id, 'nema-5-15'.

ports.name: Edison Out 2
ports.note: Real connector: NEMA 5-20 (Edison) straight-blade receptacle, 20A/125VAC. Proxied to 'nema-5-15' (closest enum id; actual is 5-20).

ports.name: Edison Out 3
ports.note: Real connector: NEMA 5-20 (Edison) straight-blade receptacle, 20A/125VAC. Proxied to 'nema-5-15' (closest enum id; actual is 5-20).
